name: Indian Barberry
summary: Indian Barberry (Berberis aristata) carries an editorial Grade A rating, but the studies recorded on this profile do not demonstrate that grade. Recorded activity centres on metabolic regulation, AMPK signaling and glucose metabolism support, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include cYP3A4 substrates and metformin (additive).
